description: This file defines a class ScreenRecordService in Swift which manages screen recording functionality using ReplayKit and AVFoundation. It includes methods for configuring, starting, stopping, and finalizing screen recordings, supporting audio and video capture with customizable parameters.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: Final class that provides screen recording capabilities, managing AVAssetWriter sessions, sample buffer handling, and ReplayKit integration.

classes.name: UncheckedSendableBox
classes.description: A generic container used to wrap a value for safe concurrent access across threads.

classes.name: CaptureState
classes.description: Internal class holding the current state of the capture session, including AVAssetWriter components, flags, locks, and error handling.

classes.name: ScreenRecordError
classes.description: Enumeration of possible errors during screen recording, providing localized descriptions.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Public async method initiating the recording process with optional parameters for screen index, duration, fps, audio inclusion, and output path. Handles the entire capture lifecycle and returns the output file path.

methods.name: makeRecordConfig
methods.description: Constructs and returns a RecordConfig object based on input parameters, applying limits and preparing output URL.

methods.name: makeOutputURL
methods.description: Generates the output URL based on provided path or defaults to a temporary file.

methods.name: startCapture
methods.description: Begins ReplayKit capture asynchronously, setting up handler functions and completion logic.

methods.name: makeCaptureHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler for processing sample buffers during capture, routing video and audio samples appropriately.

methods.name: handleVideoSample
methods.description: Processes video samples, manages writer initialization, and appends video frame data.

methods.name: prepareWriter
methods.description: Initializes AVAssetWriter and inputs, configuring video and optional audio inputs, and starts writing session.

methods.name: handleAudioSample
methods.description: Processes audio samples and appends them to the audio input if capture is active.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Finalizes the recording session, marking inputs as finished and checking for capture errors.

methods.name: finishWriting
methods.description: Completes writing to the output file asynchronously, handling errors during finalization.
